title: Uncloud Exhibition 2024
excerpt: The 2024 exhibition edition of Uncloud, the Utrecht platform for interdisciplinary art and experimental sound.
description: The 2024 exhibition edition of Uncloud, the platform for interdisciplinary art and experimental sound Jaco Schilp co-founded with Skander Jaibi in Utrecht. The aftermovie carries the atmosphere; the full story of the edition follows.
